Resume evidence [resume-s1] explicitly states designing Python web services and following RESTful interface principles, which directly satisfies the requirement for Python REST API development experience.
Optionally strengthen the resume by specifying frameworks/tools used (e.g., Flask, Django REST Framework), types/number of endpoints or services built, testing/deployment practices, or project context — but do not add specifics unless they are true and can be supported.

resume-s1 explicitly states the candidate deployed containerised services to Amazon Web Services using managed compute, which directly demonstrates hands-on AWS deployment experience. resume-s2 only references documentation and does not itself demonstrate deployment activity.
To strengthen the match, explicitly list the AWS services and deployment tools used (e.g., ECS/EKS/EC2, load balancers, CI/CD), describe specific hands-on tasks performed (e.g., configuring clusters, pushing images, running deployments), and, if possible, note scope or frequency of deployments.

None of the supplied resume items mention Python. Evidence describes Java services and build/release scripts/documentation but does not state development in Python or use of Python tools/libraries, so the requirement is not supported.
If the candidate has professional Python experience, add explicit resume lines such as: role/title, employer, dates, and concrete bullet(s) stating Python development work (e.g., libraries/frameworks used, components built, scope). If no Python experience exists, consider training or projects to gain demonstrable professional Python experience before applying.

Resume evidence resume-s1 explicitly states the candidate 'demonstrated teamwork by pairing with engineers and designers across two product squads,' which directly shows cross-functional collaboration and satisfies the requirement for teamwork skills.
To strengthen the match, the resume could add brief, supported details about the nature or impact of the teamwork (e.g., outcomes achieved, scope of collaboration, or duration) without inventing new experiences.

Resume item [resume-s1] shows written communication ability (wrote technical documentation). There is no supplied evidence demonstrating verbal communication (presentations, meetings, stakeholder briefings, or similar), so the requirement for both excellent verbal and written skills is not fully met.

Keep descriptions factual and include audience or context where possible (e.g., "Presented weekly release updates to cross-functional team of X").
